title: The Altered Trade Documents
brief: A simulated Corporate Bank trade-finance file contains inconsistent invoices, a new shipping route and an unexplained intermediary.
objective: Identify trade-based money-laundering indicators and escalate the file without losing evidence.

nodes.speaker: Trade Finance Specialist
nodes.message: The invoice value increased by 40%, the goods description changed, and payment now passes through a new intermediary in another jurisdiction.
nodes.prompt: How do you handle the document set?

artifact.title: Trade document discrepancy
artifact.body: Invoice, bill of lading and routing instructions contain material inconsistencies.

choices.label: Pause processing, preserve the documents and escalate the combined indicators.
choices.consequence: The indicators remain linked and available for an AML assessment.

choices.label: Ask the client to correct only the invoice and continue.
choices.consequence: The wider routing and intermediary risks remain unexamined.

choices.label: Process because the customer has a long relationship with the bank.
choices.consequence: Customer familiarity suppresses review of unusual trade activity.
